limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Macro data with global relevance: US Q3 GDP 3.4%, NZ unemployment 5.7% multi-report, IMF Hungary upgrade, China manufacturing contraction, Spain unemployment, World Bank Kenya corruption warning, US jobs report preview and Norway unemployment. Excluded local city and youth-program items.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Ranked by verified market-moving supply/price changes and authoritative data: oil plunge on Iran peace hopes after midterms, strike on Iran's Qeshm lifting prices, ADNOC-TotalEnergies LNG deal, Namibia fuel storage project, EIA refinery data, market dislocation warning, Russian gas restoration push, and BoJ oil-shock minutes. Excluded local pump-price and promotional pieces.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Selected genuine stress signals: record cash withdrawals after stockpiling advice, systemic-risk ranking of geopolitical/AI cyber threats, RBA mortgage stress tests, loan talks near default deadline, retail stress on bank balance sheets, foreclosure ruling, emergency credit to default-hit group, and fuel costs hitting airline profits. Excluded how-to, CD-rate and local governance items.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified regulatory and coverage state changes: FDA lenacapavir approval, first cellular therapy for T1D, generic venetoclax approval, court block on Medicaid frailty rule, NC Medicaid expansion, Democrats' pledge to reverse Medicaid/ACA changes, Medicare Advantage losses, and FDA orphan designation. Excluded Medicare how-to, scams and local seminars.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Selected verified state changes and authoritative geopolitical developments with global transmission: US-Iran war escalation/wider-war warning, IDF strike in Lebanon, Russian strikes on Ukraine power, new Iran sanctions, ammo strain, UN peacekeeping vacuum, UK sanctions on Sudan, and Haiti gang/UN talks. Penalized speculation, local crime, stock-picking and promotional items.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Authoritative inflation prints and central-bank actions dominate: Euro area 4.0% inflation, BoE hike to 4%, Sweden hike, Fed hike case, Brazil hold, China FX reserve ratio, SNB second-round watch, and US services inflation. Excluded political commentary and single-country opinion.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified political state changes with market transmission: Democratic sweep of Congress, Israel coalition formation, Florida flood emergency expansion, Belize state of emergency alert, election-interference fears fizzling, health-policy reorder, India impact explainer and Iowa balance-of-power. Excluded opinion, wildfire-local, and entertainment items.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Market-moving precious-metals developments: election-driven gold/silver jump, fastest central-bank buying, illegal Indian imports surge, Citi $5,000 target on Fed pivot, China gold consumption, Canada gold exports, Pakistan/Bangladesh price jumps, and Guinea ex-bank chief gold charges. Excluded mining promotions and non-metals 'gold' puns.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Verified corporate/regulatory and market events: Apple warning on memory-chip prices, EU chip-design investment, SpaceX AI chip financing, Lambda data center, post-election rotation out of AI/chip stocks, clustered voter rejection of data centers, Marvell-Lumentum deal, Qualcomm miss. Excluded misleading 'chip' food items and stock-picking.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy/state changes with cross-border transmission: tariff swaps on Canadian goods, EV tariffs on China, White House action on tariff evasion across 40+ countries, China tariff relief for Canadian products, Canada-US surplus data, Malaysia-US trade, Canada trade push to China, and Mercedes production delay. Excluded opinion and local-pressure items.
